title: RNAi by Feeding in Euplotes focardii
author: Francesca Papi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zk8f4zw

steps.title: Grow E.coli strain HT115
steps.instruction: Grow RNAse III deficient E.coli strain HT115 in LB medium with antibiotic selection overnight at 37°C.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial culture dilution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:100 dilution of the bacterial culture and grow it at 37°C until the OD600 reaches 0.4.

steps.title: Induce RNA transcription
steps.instruction: Induce RNA transcription from the L4440 plasmid (containing the gene of interest or empty vector for control) by adding 0.4 mM IPTG and growing the bacteria at 37°C until they reach an OD600 of 1.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend bacteria
steps.instruction: Collect, wash, and resuspend the bacteria for feeding.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge bacteria at 7000 rpm for 8 minutes.
Wash the pellet twice with ddH2O.
Resuspend in 1.5 ml of sea water (at 4°C) to an OD600 of 4.

steps.title: Feed Euplotes focardii
steps.instruction: Feed 100 ml of Euplotes focardii culture (cell density ~3000 cells/ml) with the prepared bacterial suspension.

substeps.instruction: Feed the culture every 3 days for at least 10 days.
